text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are men, meaning sex was not a differentiating factor in choosing him over you. While an all-male panel may point to broader institutional diversity issues within the hospital's senior leadership or recruitment processes, it provides no basis for a claim of sex discrimination in your specific case. Raising this point would appear unfounded and could damage your professional credibility. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting the written feedback you were promised. Focus your inquiry on how the panel evaluated qualifications and leadership experience, specifically how your PhD and eight years running a section compared against the successful candidate’s management training and leadership background.
